note: Trigger-routing suite. expect=trigger: the skill should fire on the prompt in a fresh session; expect=no-trigger: a near-miss owned elsewhere (owner in comment). dispatch-ticket is invoked BY NAME from /build-feature, build-leader, or /lead-build — never model-routed from a raw ask (its own description states this); the trigger cases below reflect that named-invocation shape.

cases.prompt: Use teamwork:dispatch-ticket to drive #240 through the shared build procedure.
build-leader here — run dispatch-ticket against ticket TKT-0042.
/lead-build session: dispatch this confirmed ticket via dispatch-ticket's kind-branched procedure.
Invoke dispatch-ticket by name on issue #318 — find or mint the record, then branch by kind.
Run dispatch-ticket's Phase 1 against this seed, prefixed [nested-intake].
dispatch-ticket: claim, isolate, and size ticket #99 per its own Phase 3/4.

cases.comment: owner: /build-feature — a raw ask, never model-routed to dispatch-ticket directly per its own description

cases.prompt: Sweep the ops queue and mobilize whatever's buildable.
cases.comment: owner: teamwork:mobilize-chores — batch find-and-confirm, not one already-confirmed ticket

cases.prompt: There's a bug in the login flow, can you file it?
cases.comment: owner: docs:file-bug — a raw recordless bug report, not a confirmed ticket dispatch
